Contract Generator.contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::closeStore(storeID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		store: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = storeID)
	precondition:
		CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = bool or
		CurrentStore.IsOpened = true
	postcondition:
		let store: Store in
		store.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(store) and
		store.IsOpened = false and
		result = true
}
